sentences.text:
Standing Coun
 Coram:
 Justice Sashikanta Mishra
Order No. Order
 1 12.06.2024
 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heardlearned counsel for the petitioner and leaned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.
3.

The petitioner is in custody since 09.04.2024 in connection with G.R. Case No. 56 of 2024 allegedly for commission of the offences punishable U/s. 376(2)(n)/294/323/34of I.P.C.
4.
The prosecution case is that the victim girl and the petitioner were in love relationship for about five years prior to the occurrence.
They also got married to each other.
However, the family members of the petitioner did not accept her as their daughter-in-law.
Furthermore, the petitioner also left her.
The allegation appears to be directed more against the family members of the petitioner inasmuch as they are said to have abused and assaulted the victim.
Nothing specific is alleged against the husband save and except that he had assisted his parents in abusing the victim.
5. This Court finds that the victim is a major girl and apparently had a willful and consensual relationship with the petitioner.
Further, the dispute appears to be domestic in nature.
6. Under such circumstances, I am inclined to allow the prayer for bail.
Let the petitioner be released on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper by the learned court below.
7. The bail application is disposed of accordingly.
8. Urgent certified copy of the bail application be granted on proper application.
